scope: No browser automation, new assets, geometry/texture/LOD changes, build, commit, push or deployment. Parent owns integration and deployment.
behavior: Existing phase1 engagement prefetch now prepares exactly one hidden pooled phase2 asset. The preparation path does not call summon, create a combat brain, enable the actor, register a shadow caster, grant rewards or emit attacks.

Separate prepareHidden and summon activation. A foreground transformation or selector joins the same pending job and reuses its committed material/outline/rig/animator/shader preparation. Cancellation checks scene identity, scene disposal, map identity and resident revision.

The exact existing bounds and zero-weight-slot algorithms now share generator proofs, yielding at512vertex boundaries. Each scheduled slice targets1.5ms and is capped at4blocks (2048vertices) in production, avoiding per-vertex clock calls. Sync and async proof use the identical operation order and do not rewrite vertex/morph/weight buffers.

Real idle/cloth/morph state is initialized after the stable11slot morph configuration and before shader preparation. No fake morph-zero, reduced influences, changed rig, LOD, outline or shadow quality is used.

Cancellation preserves disabled partial work. Explicit later activation resumes committed steps without duplicating outlines, morph managers or resident instances. A failed background shader prepare reports failure once; update does not retry. One explicit subsequent summon can reuse completed proofs and finish compilation.

A final lifetime audit reproduced a never-resolving old shader Promise pinning both background and foreground jobs. Preparation now owns abortable waits with one45000ms deadline; Battle.hide cancels immediately, including queued rAF/fallback/poll timers. Late model acquisition is shared once and can only adopt into a disabled owner.

Boss warmup no longer calls Babylon forceCompilationAsync or starts its private unbounded16ms polling. The current PBR submesh and ShaderMaterial variants are checked directly, without instances, every16ms while unready; error, cancel or timeout unwinds and restores every borrowed allowShaderHotSwapping value in finally.
